title: Collisions of random walks in unimodular random graphs: applications to the random geometric graph and long-range percolation
summary: We study collision properties of simple random walks in unimodular random rooted graphs. This work continues the study initiated in~\cite{HutchcroftPeres2015}: under recurrence and an integrability condition on the root, two independent random walks collide infinitely often a.s. We prove that, under transience and an integrability assumption involving the Green function on the root, two independent random walks collide only finitely often a.s.
